summary: @servicetitan/docs-uikit ships preinstall dropper that downloads Bun and executes obfuscated bundle
details: Package declares purpose as 'Documentation content for Uikit packages' and declares only 'docs' in package.json files[], but the tarball root ships setup.mjs and a 727KB math_init.js payload, and package.json.scripts.preinstall runs `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at a pinned version, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the bundled math_init.js. Both files are obfuscated: setup.mjs uses hex-named identifiers (_0x488df8, _0x52943e) with per-call literal dictionaries; math_init.js is a Bun-CJS bundle beginning with a rotated numeric-literal array and an array-shift decoder function (WV8StW) matching obfuscator.io output. The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern (fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute an opaque sibling bundle) evades Node-based static analysis, and the payload is executed automatically on `npm install` before any user code runs. The scope name matches ServiceTitan, consistent with a name-squat or maintainer-account hijack against the @servicetitan npm scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
